topic: Workshop location selection and accommodation planning
summary_markdown:
The group discussed potential locations for the AllUnite Workshop 2021, comparing two options: Eris Luxur and Villa Elena. Initial discussion involved voting to select a preferred venue.

Regarding accommodation, the conversation shifted to whether individual rooms or shared rooms would be necessary. Multiple participants indicated that sharing a room was acceptable (p3, p2, p4, [me]). The group also noted that while villas offer privacy and hotels might offer better amenities like breakfast.
decisions: The workshop location selection is pending the results of a poll/vote.
